scripts.assets:characters: /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b --factory-startup --python scripts/blender/build_character_kit.py -- art-source/quaternius public/assets/models/character_kit.glb && node scripts/compress-models.mjs public/assets/models/character_kit.glb && npm run assets:mobile
scripts.assets:models: for n in rookie alex don victor lucas; do /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b --factory-startup --python scripts/blender/build_character.py -- $n && node scripts/optimize-character.mjs public/assets/models/$n.glb && node scripts/simplify-character.mjs public/assets/models/$n.glb && node scripts/grade-character.mjs public/assets/models/$n.glb && node scripts/fix-character-contacts.mjs public/assets/models/$n.glb && node scripts/compress-models.mjs public/assets/models/$n.glb || exit 1; done && npm run assets:mobile
scripts.assets:avatar: /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b --factory-startup --python scripts/blender/render_avatar.py -- art-source/models-uncompressed/rookie.glb art-source/avatar_rookie.png && cwebp -quiet -q 90 art-source/avatar_rookie.png -o public/assets/ui/avatar_rookie.webp
scripts.assets:cars: /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b --factory-startup --python scripts/blender/build_cars.py && node scripts/compress-models.mjs public/assets/models/environment/sedan.glb public/assets/models/environment/sedan_sports.glb public/assets/models/environment/suv.glb public/assets/models/environment/taxi.glb public/assets/models/environment/van.glb
scripts.assets:menu-cast: /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b --factory-startup --python scripts/blender/render_menu_cast.py -- art-source/models-uncompressed art-source/menu_cast.png && cwebp -quiet -q 86 -alpha_q 90 -crop 0 240 1100 910 art-source/menu_cast.png -o public/assets/ui/menu_cast.webp
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run build && cap sync && node scripts/trim-android-audio.mjs
scripts.mobile:android: npm run mobile:sync && cap open android
scripts.mobile:ios: npm run mobile:sync && cap open ios
scripts.mobile:run:android: npm run mobile:sync && cap run android
scripts.mobile:run:ios: npm run mobile:sync && cap run ios
